thread:
Jordan K: Heads-up: Jetstream.ai says they were charged overage on INV-2026-05-20-JK even though they have a reserved capacity commitment. They want a credit.

billing-bot: Invoice INV-2026-05-20-JK posted 2026-05-20 10:02Z. Total: $2,750.00. Status: paid. PDF: https://billing.redwood.internal/invoices/INV-2026-05-20-JK

Mina (Acct Rep): Customerprovided invoice screenshot and contract excerpt showing Reserved Pool 2 (commit 100k tokens/mo) active from 2026-04-01. They were billed an overage line: Overage tokens 5,000 @ $0.25 = $1,250.

Oleg (Cust Eng): We verified usage events. Some requests were tagged to a legacy project ID not mapped to their reserved pool, so usage was billed as on-demand. Looks like mapping rule drop during account migration.

Jordan K: pasted invoice lines:
```
acct,line,desc,qty,unit_price,line_total
JK-777,1,Reserved pool - monthly,1,1500.00,1500.00
JK-777,2,On-demand tokens - overage,5000,0.25,1250.00
```

Jordan K: So customer should not be charged the $1,250 overage. They ask for an account credit (not CC refund).

Mina (Acct Rep): Customer prefers credit to future invoices. We can issue credit memo and apply to next billing cycle. Need Dir Finance sign-off for moving posted invoice to zero balance via credit.

Priya (Dir Finance): Approve account credit. Use adj code FIN-OVG-2026-099. Please ensure root cause notes and ticket to eng-billing for mapping fix.

FinanceBot: Creating credit memo CM-2026-2001 amount -1250.00 linked to INV-2026-05-20-JK. Reference FIN-OVG-2026-099. Status: applied as account credit.

Mina (Acct Rep): CM-2026-2001 posted and applied. New invoice balance: $1,500.00 (reserved pool only). Note: customer will see $1,250 credit on next invoice. Added note: "mapping rule dropped during migration; eng-billing ticket BI-2026-711 created."

Oleg (Cust Eng): Opening BI-2026-711 to add idempotent mapping checks and a billing QA case. I'll attach sample request ids.

Jordan K: Ive updated Jetstreamcase and told them credit is applied to account. Theyacknowledged and appreciate the fix.

Mina (Acct Rep): Closing this thread. Will monitor next invoice to confirm credit consumption.
